Notification UX uses one shared renderer/CSS and the canonical preferences; Web explicitly has no authorized delivery adapter. Native updater ownership is unchanged. 2026-10-13: Web composition injects the canonical provider-neutral Intelligence client through a fail-closed unavailable Web adapter; no provider API, secret, inference authority or tool execution is introduced. 2026-10-14: user-requested Meridian presentation; shared tokens, explicit planned examples and existing canonical owners retained. Web composes the canonical bundled Profile catalog reader without activation, credentials or a new backend. 2026-10-16: reviewed current shared Meridian/journey imports; canonical Web ports and Native runtime boundaries are unchanged. 2026-10-16: Web production entry now fail-closes before mounting until the same-origin session is signed in; layout-proof bypass remains loopback-only and remote hosts retain normal authentication authority. 2026-10-18: Web composition delegates the latest unified Meridian navigation and Home layers while preserving the shared host/session boundaries. 2026-10-20: Web-only responsive behavior is imported from its composition boundary, while Settings journey styles are explicitly included; shared Surface rules no longer carry Web-specific responsive overrides.
